hyperedges.label: Per-tool entry points converging on one product contract
Daily runtime → KPI computation pipeline
FOUNDATION provisioning dependency chain (skeleton → readiness → journey)
Grilling session writes CONTEXT.md and ADRs inline
ISA-95 location tree levels (Tenant → Enterprise → Site → Area → Work Center → Work Unit)
KPI binding resolution chain: work unit → placement → asset tag → slot → transform → result
MolcaDx agent roster: PO orchestrating two domain agents
Availability time walk: POT → planned DT → PBT → unplanned DT → APT
OEE calculation chain (A x P x Q from shopfloor entries)
Q3 PRD lineage — PRD-002 absorbed into PRD-001 v0.2, PRD-003 forked for FOUNDATION
PRD quality gate: format, standard, metrics, readiness
SCR-FND-SIT-002 absorbs retired Shift and Fiscal screens
Shift lifecycle — start, capture, close, correct
OEE computation chain from shift, sensor tags and asset placement
Same skills mirrored byte-identically across Claude, Cursor, and Antigravity
